• The Workshop Status is about what's happening in the room -- what's in progress, up next, not started, etc. or Entered Free Text.
  • The following Statuses can have free text added: Free Text, In Car, and Take Onsite.
  • Tickets are updated with all Workshop Board changes, information, equipment, and progress notes & status changes.

extendedHelp:
About Workshop Jobs and the Workshop Board

The Workshop Status is about what's happening in the room and can be thought of as "The Workshop Whiteboard"

All jobs have Tickets.
Workshop job flow and job status information is an independent process about the actual workshop tasks.
Tickets get updated with the workshop job info changes when they happen.

How Tickets relate to the Workshop Board
The only information on the Workshop Board that comes from the ticket is Client, Ticket Status, and Due Date

What happens when I ...
  • Enter a Ticket Number: When a ticket number is entered, the ticket gets updated with all of the available information in the Workshop Job.
  • Change a Ticket Number: If a ticket number is changed, the old ticket will be noted with the new ticket number, and all historical info will be added to the new ticket.
  • Delete/Clear a Ticket Number: The ticket will be updated to say that this Ticket Number was manually removed from a Workshop job


About Workshop Status (different to ticket status) ...

Equipment is still present at Ambient iT
  1. A ticket must exist and NOT be Complete (also not Billing - Contract)
  2. If the workshop work is complete but the equipment is still here, choose a suitable colour dot and status text.

About the Equipment Location:

The cute little buttons at the end of the row:
  1. Clock: Show History
  2. Printer: Print a job card to attach to equipment
  3. Camera: Upload or take a photo
  4. Pencil: Edit the job
  5. Green Tick: Mark job as complete.  

Marking a Workshop Job as Complete ...
  • Removes the job from the Workshop board.
  • Does not close the ticket.
  • Is recoverable from the "Completed Jobs" view
